mechanical_correspondence.requested_393_interpretation: The selected PCB has 400 physical contacts. Seven are currently named product signal contacts, leaving 393 remaining physical contacts; the contract maps all 400, rather than silently dropping seven.
mechanical_correspondence.reference_convention: letters A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,J,K and numbers 1..40; contact identifier is <letter><number>
mechanical_correspondence.transformation: identity: local x = reference x; local y = reference y; no mirror/rotation/translation in footprint-local coordinates
mechanical_correspondence.proof: 400/400 shared identifiers, 0 coordinate mismatches, zero-error identity transform in retained crosscheck; current selected PCB independently reproduces the 10x40 nominal grid with max error 0.0 mm

classification_disposition.corroborated_contacts: All 130 current 12V_PROTECTED pads match the indexed 12V row set; all 170 current POWER_GND pads match the indexed ground set; seven selected signal pads match the indexed x1/reference/reset contacts.
classification_disposition.conflicting_contacts: No authoritative contact-level conflict for the bounded selected x1/power/ground contract. The 3890p/4090ovo PCBdoc is retained as low-confidence conflicting evidence: it lacks documented connector orientation/source hardware and is not used to reassign PiSXMe.
classification_disposition.genuinely_unknown_unmapped: 31 source-declared NC/project-unknown contacts and K18/K19 auxiliary/protection contacts remain no-net; 60 additional published PCIe contacts are unimplemented by the selected x1 product and remain unassigned.
classification_disposition.12v_contacts: Rows 22,23,25,26,28,29,31,32,34,35,37,38,40 across all ten columns; 130 total; current net 12V_PROTECTED.
classification_disposition.gnd_contacts: Rows 21,24,27,30,33,36,39 plus indexed signal-region grounds; 170 total; current net POWER_GND.
classification_disposition.pcie_reference_reset: 64 published PCIe data contacts (4 selected for x1, 60 intentionally unimplemented), E7/F7 REFCLK, E18 PERST; current selected assignments only those required x1 contacts.
classification_disposition.auxiliary_thermal: K18 Prot/Cathode and K19 Prot/GND are auxiliary/protection unknowns; no thermal contact assignment is invented.

authority_disposition.decision: No schematic, footprint, or net correction is required from this package. Preserve unknown/no-net contacts. Existing J1 contract is mechanically and electrically bounded for the selected x1/power/ground scope.
authority_disposition.responsible_authority: package/footprint authority with electrical interface authority; Root records disposition
authority_disposition.limits: This does not prove undocumented V100 auxiliary behavior, fabricated-hardware continuity, connector assembly yield, power adequacy, procurement, or integrated-board DRC/connectivity.
